fields.name: Compressor Operating Pressure
fields.description: Verify high-side and low-side refrigerant pressure gauge readings.
fields.remark: High-side at 320 PSI, low-side at 118 PSI (within OEM spec).

fields.name: Air Intake Filtration Check
fields.description: Inspect pre-filters and primary HEPA filtration media for particulate accumulation.
fields.remark: Filters reached 85% restriction threshold. Replaced with fresh units.
fields.suggestion: Scheduled next filter inspection in 90 days.

fields.name: Emergency Overspeed Governor
fields.description: Trip governor switch and measure physical actuation time.
fields.remark: Governor tripped at 1.15 m/s. Safe threshold verified.
fields.suggestion: Keep contact points lubricated with non-acidic synthetic grease.

fields.name: Optical Door Safety Curtains
fields.description: Test multi-beam infrared safety light curtains across car doorway.
fields.remark: All 32 optical channels responsive. Instant reopen on beam obstruction.
fields.suggestion: Regularly wipe optical lenses to avoid dust build-up.

fields.name: Common Rail Fuel Delivery Line
fields.description: Pressure test the high-pressure diesel fuel delivery circuit.
fields.remark: Internal seals failed in pump delivery manifold. Pressure dropping below 300 bar.
fields.suggestion: Full pump replacement required immediately before load test.

fields.name: Starter Motor 24V Cranking Batteries
fields.description: Test cold cranking amperage and terminal impedance on lead-acid bank.
fields.remark: Battery bank healthy, 25.1V float charge, 24.2V under crank load.

fields.name: Central Fire Alarm Loop Communicator
fields.description: Simulate alarm signal transmission to local monitoring dispatch station.
fields.remark: Dual-path cellular and IP transmitters communicated within 4.2 seconds.
fields.suggestion: Continue monthly automated silent comm check.

fields.name: Blower Motor Serpentine Belt
fields.description: Inspect belt tension and visual wear on blower drive assembly.
fields.remark: Belt showed micro-cracking. Replaced with new EPDM heavy-duty belt.
fields.suggestion: Check deflection tension again in 30 days.
